title: Full Day Pontiac Wine & Cider Tour - Day Trip From Ottawa & Gatineau
includes: Free pickup and drop-off from Gatineau & Ottawa
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Join Aventure Outaouais for Ottawa's best selling wine & cider tour during which you can enjoy 12 generous tastings of wine & cider from 3 incredible family-run locations, amazing local foods, all while learning about the history of the Pontiac region and the process of making such amazing products. Plus, sit back and enjoy the breathtaking landscapes throughout the day as we take care of the driving. Best part is, we bring you to only family-run wineries and cider mills where you are hosted by the owners and they make sure you have a unique and authentic experience.
